_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

0EF5.name: StartCoolantFactor
0EF5.desc: Subsystem: initialisation at reset (by the routine that reads it, Reset). Inputs: CoolantTemp. Result to BatteryTemp, $0A5B,Z.

4064.name: StartStartCoolant
4064.desc: Subsystem: initialisation at reset (by the routine that reads it, Reset). Inputs: StartCoolantTemp2. Result to $0C00,Z.

4070.name: FlexLearnTable2
4070.desc: Subsystem: flex-fuel ethanol content learning (by the routine that reads it, Sub_17A48). Inputs: ?; $01BB,Z; $01BC,Z. Result to $0F25,Z, $01B9,Z, $01BA,Z.

4094.name: CrankEthanolScale
4094.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

04A1.name: PartThrottleMapScale
04A1.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0495.name: DecelMapScale
0495.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

0FB2.name: FlexEthanolScale
0FB2.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content ($0198,Z) to the scaled value $0A91,Z used as table input

0F9A.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0F9A.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0FA6.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0FA6.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

04DD.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
04DD.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

42EC.name: PurgeMapScale
42EC.desc: Subsystem: EVAP purge control, probable (by the routine that reads it, Sub_3EAEC). Inputs: Map.

42E2.name: PurgeRpm
42E2.desc: Subsystem: EVAP purge control, probable (by the routine that reads it, Sub_3EAEC). Inputs: EngineRpm. Result to $00F0,Z.

4118.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
4118.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

04D1.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
04D1.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

04E9.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
04E9.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

0501.name: MisfireV0620Scale2
0501.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: $0620,Z.

04AD.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
04AD.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

0531.name: IacRollThrottleScale
0531.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

04C5.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
04C5.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

4353.name: IacFieldDutyScale
4353.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

435F.name: IacBaroScale
435F.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IacBaseBaroTarget2

059C.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
059C.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into $076B,Z

05CE.name: CrankBasePulse
05CE.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content ($0A91,Z, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into $0766,Z

056C.name: CrankRpmDecay
056C.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0576.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0576.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

058C.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
058C.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant

0594.name: CrankV0769Decay
0594.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against $0769,Z; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0545.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0545.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

05AD.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
05AD.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into $0765,Z

064F.name: CrankCoolantAdder
064F.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events ($0C44,Z), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant $0768,Z

0658.name: InjectorDeadTime
0658.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

147E.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
147E.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse ($0780,Z / $0782,Z) during the change of injection mode in Sub_112A8

07D5.name: PartThrottleFuel
07D5.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0E70.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E70.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0A21.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0A21.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor ($077A,Z) in

1A13.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
1A13.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while $0D02,Z bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0F61.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0F61.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT ($07AA,Z), against rpm

0728.name: WotFuel
0728.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0EC3.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
0EC3.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

0452.name: StartCoolant
0452.desc: Subsystem: initialisation at reset (by the routine that reads it, Reset). Inputs: CoolantTemp. Result to $07C4,Z.

0FBC.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
0FBC.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into $07C0,Z

0FCE.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
0FCE.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into $07BF,Z

0F86.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
0F86.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast ($0A7F,Z) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

0F77.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
0F77.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

4054.name: StartTable
4054.desc: Subsystem: initialisation at reset (by the routine that reads it, Reset). Inputs: TBA. Result to $0A6B,Z.

0F8E.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
0F8E.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is $07C2,Z

0FE0.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
0FE0.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

0FF4.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
0FF4.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

1008.name: DecelLeanAirflow
1008.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to $0804,Z

10A4.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
10A4.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into $07C1,Z

0F2C.name: EventCoolant
0F2C.desc: Subsystem: reference-event interrupt (input capture 1) (by the routine that reads it, Isr_GPT_IC1). Inputs: CoolantTemp. Result to FuelPulseAdder.

12DF.name: O2VoltageScale2
12DF.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1199.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1199.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag ($0770,Z bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

1427.name: PurgeTable
1427.desc: Subsystem: EVAP purge control, probable (by the routine that reads it, Sub_3EAEC). Inputs: result of Lookup2D.

1691.name: CoolantSparkMap
1691.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed

1B09.name: AirTempSparkFactor
1B09.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or $0A5A,Z with calibration bit $0330.5 clear)

1AB4.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1AB4.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1A21.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1A21.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into $0D1B,Z

1958.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1958.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

19FD.name: DecelSpark
19FD.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

1A0B.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
1A0B.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1D4A.name: EventSparkThrottle
1D4A.desc: Upper limit of the event spark $0859,Z against throttle while $0856,Z bits 4 and 2 are set (raised by $205D per loop)

1D54.name: EventSparkThrottle2
1D54.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while $0856,Z bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

1BBB.name: SurgeJerkRetardOpen
1BBB.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: retard against positive rpm jerk (above $2173)

1BC3.name: SurgeJerkAdvanceOpen
1BC3.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: spark against negative rpm jerk (below $2172)

1BF3.name: SurgeRateThreshold
1BF3.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm acceleration ($0D26,Z) that starts the retard, against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1C01.name: SurgeRetardGearFactor
1C01.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the base retard against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BDB.name: SurgeRetardRateFactor
1BDB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against rpm acceleration $0D26,Z

1BE7.name: SurgeRetardMapRiseFactor
1BE7.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against MAP rise $0D3B,Z (MAP minus filtered MAP); result into $0D33,Z

1B76.name: SurgeDecay
1B76.desc: Driveline surge spark control: decay factor of the retard against gear (rows) and time in the decay stage $0D37,Z (columns)

1C0F.name: SurgeJerkThreshold
1C0F.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm jerk ($0D30,Z) above which the jerk retard applies, against the rpm/speed ratio

1BAF.name: SurgeRetardCoolantFactor
1BAF.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against coolant

1B34.name: SurgeJerkGain
1B34.desc: Driveline surge spark control: jerk retard gain against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns)

1B13.name: SurgeJerkLimit
1B13.desc: Driveline surge spark control: limit of the jerk retard against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns), into $0D36,Z

1C59.name: AcSparkRateUp
1C59.desc: A/C spark compensation: spark against positive rpm rate $0D4A,Z, into $0D55,Z

1C61.name: AcSparkRateDown
1C61.desc: As AcSparkRateUp against negative rpm rate, A/C clutch off

1C69.name: AcSparkRateDownAcOn
1C69.desc: As AcSparkRateDown with the A/C clutch on

1C71.name: AcSparkMapLimit
1C71.desc: Limit of the A/C spark compensation against MAP

16EE.name: FlexSparkMapRpm
16EE.desc: Flex-fuel spark change, MAP x rpm, minus $0D03,Z, weighted by FlexSparkEthanolWeight

1A5A.name: FlexSparkEthanolWeight
1A5A.desc: Weight of FlexSparkMapRpm against ethanol content

1CBB.name: KnockThreshold
1CBB.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

1CD4.name: KnockRetardStep
1CD4.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold ($0A8B,Z minus KnockThresholdNow)

1CCB.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CCB.desc: Maximum knock retard ($0DAA,Z) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

1AF3.name: AirTempSparkFactor2
1AF3.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMap against intake air temperature

1AFD.name: AirTempSparkMap
1AFD.desc: Second air-temperature spark term against MAP (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor2

1F69.name: IacGearDelayCoolant
1F69.desc: Delay timer ($0349,Z) started when $0C31,Z bit 7 sets, against coolant

1F87.name: IacGearTimeFactor
1F87.desc: Factor on IacGearTimeCoolant against the time counter $0348,Z

1F91.name: IacDroopStepCoolant
1F91.desc: IAC opening when the rpm drops below the target in gear ($0317,Z bit 3, $0C31,Z bit 7), against coolant

1FA3.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPNAC
1FA3.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N with A/C requested

1FAD.name: IacGearTimeFactorPNAC
1FAD.desc: As IacGearTimeFactor in P/N with A/C requested

1FCA.name: IacAcKickMap
1FCA.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch engages, against MAP (MAP latched into $0341,Z); into $0340,Z

1FD2.name: IacAcKickMapLatched
1FD2.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch releases, against the MAP latched at engagement ($0341,Z)

1FED.name: IacRunTimeAdder
1FED.desc: IAC addition against time since start

1FF5.name: IacCoastCoolant
1FF5.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against coolant; the higher of this and IacCoastSpeedRpm applies

2003.name: IacCoastThrottleLimit
2003.desc: Throttle opening limit for the coasting idle air

208F.name: IacRollSpeedBase
208F.desc: IAC target while rolling: base against vehicle speed

209B.name: IacRollFactorV0345
209B.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against $0345,Z (centred on 128), with calibration bit $0331.7

20A7.name: IacRollFactorBattTemp
20A7.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against battery temperature (centred on 128)

20B1.name: IacRollRpmFactor2
20B1.desc: Second rolling IAC factor against segment rpm

20BB.name: IacRollRpmFactor
20BB.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against segment rpm

20C5.name: IacRollThrottleRpm
20C5.desc: IAC target while rolling: addition against throttle (rows) and segment rpm (signed); result into $0366,Z limited by $2642

200D.name: IacCoastSpeedRpm
200D.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against vehicle speed (rows) and segment rpm

220F.name: IacStepBaroFactor
220F.desc: Multiplier on IAC steps and start positions against barometric pressure

2219.name: IacShiftBaroFactor
2219.desc: Multiplier on the gear-change IAC step and the initial IAC value against barometric pressure

2223.name: IacKickBaroFactor
2223.desc: Factor on the A/C and rpm-dip IAC steps against barometric pressure

206A.name: IacFieldDutyRpm
206A.desc: IAC addition against field duty (rows) and segment rpm (columns), into $F4,Z

212F.name: IacFieldDutyRpm2
212F.desc: Second field-duty table against segment rpm, into $F7,Z (MAP offset for the learned idle MAP)

21DC.name: IdleMapBase
21DC.desc: Base of the idle MAP target ($031E,Z, via $F5,Z): barometric pressure (rows) and idle target rpm (columns)

21D3.name: IacStartBaro
21D3.desc: Idle air position at reset against barometric pressure, into $2A,Z

21B2.name: IacBaseBaroTarget
21B2.desc: Base idle air (IAC position) against barometric pressure (rows) and the idle target (columns), into $0362,Z; added to the IAC target

0519.name: MisfireV0620
0519.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: $0620,Z. Result to $04FE,Z.

26FA.name: MisfireV06202
26FA.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: $0620,Z.

27F5.name: MisfireV0620V05C6Factor
27F5.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: result of Lookup2D x $05C6,Z.

28AF.name: MisfireV0620V05C6Factor3
28AF.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: result of Lookup2D x $05C6,Z.

271A.name: MisfireV04FEV05C6
271A.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: $04FE,Z x $05C6,Z. Result to $04FE,Z.

2777.name: MisfireV04FEScaled
2777.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: result of Lookup3D x result of Lookup3D. Result to $04FF,Z.

27D4.name: MisfireV0620CoolantFactor
27D4.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: result of Lookup2D x CoolantTemp. Result to $05E2,Z.

26DA.name: MisfireSegRpm
26DA.desc: Subsystem: misfire monitor (crankshaft segment times) (by the routine that reads it, Sub_2AC02). Inputs: SegmentRpm. Result to $0629,Z.

2992.name: DiagV019CLimit
2992.desc: Subsystem: on-board diagnostic monitors (by the routine that reads it, Sub_25784). Inputs: $019C,Z.

2348.name: DiagV019CLimit2
2348.desc: Subsystem: on-board diagnostic monitors (by the routine that reads it, Sub_25784). Inputs: $019C,Z.

3DF8.name: MapLimpFromThrottle
3DF8.desc: Substitute MAP from the throttle position when the MAP sensor has failed

4024.name: ThermistorCold
4024.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, cold range (-55 to 83 C), used after the pull-up is switched

4034.name: ThermistorHot
4034.desc: Thermistor ADC counts to temperature, hot range (13 to 127 C); coolant and intake air

4088.name: StartV0A87
4088.desc: Subsystem: initialisation at reset (by the routine that reads it, Reset). Inputs: $0A87,Z. Result to AcSensor.

409C.name: DwellRpmScale
409C.desc: Rpm to column position of DwellTime

40B0.name: DwellVoltsScale
40B0.desc: Battery voltage to row position of DwellTime

40C4.name: DwellTime
40C4.desc: Coil dwell against battery voltage and rpm (both as positions)

51ED.name: EventV0D11Limit
51ED.desc: Subsystem: reference-event interrupt (input capture 1) (by the routine that reads it, Isr_GPT_IC1). Inputs: $0D11,Z. Result to $791E,Z.

51FF.name: FuelEventCalAdder
51FF.desc: Subsystem: fuel calculation per reference event (by the routine that reads it, Sub_12680). Inputs: $0A83; $7563.

0669.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0669.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

066A.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
066A.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0667.name: WotFuelK
0667.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0668.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0668.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

110B.name: RevLimit
110B.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is set (2GNT: manual transmission / park-neutral)

110D.name: RevLimitAlt
110D.desc: Rev limit, used while $0C31,Z bit 5 is clear

3530.name: FaultTable
3530.desc: Fault attributes: id, trigger count, blink code, attributes, bit mask, byte offset, P-code (BCD), 2 spare bytes
